title: Emission chain of the generator
statement: For natural numbers $c,C,q$, a Boolean input word $x$, arbitrary work-head positions $h : 	ext{Fin}(c+1) \to \mathbb{Z}$, an output word $o$, and $j \le C$, starting with the generator in emission state $j$, work-head positions $h$, and output $o$, after exactly $j+1$ steps it is in advance state $0$ with the same work-head positions and output $o$ followed by $j$ ones.
hypotheses_covered: $h$ assigns an integer position to each work-tape head
replaced:
From the generator's emission state with counter $j \le C$, exactly $j+1$
steps append $j$ ones to the output and enter the innermost advance state,
leaving every head position unchanged.
